name: preview_flow_status
title: Preview switching a flow on or off
description:
What switching a flow on (`active`) or a live flow off (`inactive`) would do, without doing it: a `summary` and a
`confirmation` code valid for 10 minutes for `set_flow_status`. Switching on runs every check, and an error refuses
it with the issues. The summary says who answers each way in, what a copy changed from its original, and whether
it was rehearsed.
